deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of the reimbursement as part of governance action enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, including estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a 100,000 ADA lost governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
The submitter was unable to recover the 100,000 ADA deposit because a Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action.
The proposal says there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The proposal says the Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that action was not approved.
The document states there are no costs or expenses associated with the treasury withdrawal beyond the reimbursement amount.
The document states there are no circumstances under which the withdrawal would be refunded to the Cardano Treasury.
The document states the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The document states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal includes an external reference to an AdaStat governance record for the Ikigai governance action.

summary: The proposal seeks 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable governance action deposit and estimated staking rewards, but most key justifications are asserted in the document with only one external governance-record reference.
